top_signals.title: Hong Kong’s First-Half Air Passenger Traffic Up 11.7%, Chan Says
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong’s airport passenger traffic jumped 11.7% on year in the first half, as the Asian financial hub hosted a variety of events and attracted more visitors, according to the city’s Financial Secretary Paul Chan.

top_signals.summary: European markets fly under the radar when compared with larger and more liquid U.S. markets, but Goldman Sachs offered to dispel some of the myths them.
